# Drop

> Send files, links and notes directly between up to three browsers. Drop uses temporary rooms and requires no account.

## Using Drop

- [Open Drop](https://roptransfer.vercel.app/): Overview and pairing instructions.
- [Create or join a room](https://roptransfer.vercel.app/app): Scan the private QR and approve the joining device.
- [Connection help](https://roptransfer.vercel.app/connection-help.html): Troubleshoot direct connections and expired sessions.

## Documentation

- [Architecture and limits](https://github.com/Pranav-Teja-Aluvala/Drop#system-architecture): WebRTC delivery, room lifetime and local setup.
- [Privacy](https://roptransfer.vercel.app/privacy.html): Data handling and retention.
- [Cookies and local data](https://roptransfer.vercel.app/cookies.html): Browser storage and offline assets.
- [Contact](https://roptransfer.vercel.app/contact.html): Support and privacy questions.
